overview: The Inner Citadel is the seat of Akhevan command and ritual authority.
details: Void cores power the citadel’s resonance engines, while temporal wards stabilize ancient Akhevan chronomancy. Xi Thall commanders oversee the remaining constructs.
hooks: A void core destabilizes, threatening to collapse the citadel.
Temporal wards flicker, revealing ancient Akhevan leaders.
A Xi Thall commander awakens from deep stasis.
Resonance engines activate, opening a passage toward Vex Thal.
